scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason:
Added Colombia Huila to the bag and opened the bag.
Confirmed shipping was €4.90 and the bag total was €17.90.
Proceeded to checkout and entered Ada Lovelace’s name, ada@example.com, 12 Rua Augusta, and Lisbon.
Placed the order successfully; order TS-7383 was confirmed and €17.90 was charged.

scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason:
Added House Espresso and Paper Filters to the bag and opened the bag.
After the initial additions, shipping was €4.90 and the total was €49.40.
Pressed the + control next to Paper Filters once.
The bag updated to free shipping with a total of €51.00.

scroll: Scrolling to Add Paper Filters to bag button
click: Clicking Add Paper Filters to the bag
scroll: Scrolling to the bag link in the header
click: Clicking the bag link (2)
analyze: the total is €49.40
assert: shipping is €4.90 and the total is €49.40
click: Clicking Add one more Paper Filters in the Paper Filters list
analyze: the total is €51.00
assert: shipping is now Free and the total is €51.00

scenarios.name: Promo code total
scenarios.reason:
Added Ethiopia Guji to the bag twice and added one Hand Grinder.
Opened the bag, entered the lowercase promo code welcome10, and applied it.
The promotion was applied successfully: the discount is −€9.10, shipping is Free, and the total is €81.90.
